title: VTC Badges — Awards — Revoke — payload
description: Take an accepted award back: revoke or stop renewing the credential that evidences it, remove the holder from the badge group where it was their last award, and tell them. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

awardId.description: The award to take back. It must be `accepted`.

reason.description: Why, kept with the audit of the change for the badge's owners and administrators. The holder is told the award was taken back, never the reason.

Response.title: VTC Badges — Awards — Revoke — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/badges/awards/revoke/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/badges/awards/revoke/0.1#response.

award.description: The award as it now stands: `state` `revoked`, `decidedAt` set. `credentialId` names the credential that evidenced it, now revoked or no longer renewed.
